collections.name: Master Reference Collection
collections.description: 13 standalone master artworks capturing distinct topological archetypes of ANOMALY — CONCEPT 3: LIQUID GEOMETRY.

collections.name: Liquid Geometry Series
collections.description: Sculptural liquid chrome, pearlescent silver, polished metallic fluid, translucent glass-like membranes and smooth flowing geometric surfaces.

artworks.brief: Gravitational Anomaly I: Slender vertical filament rising against gravity from a reflective pool toward a suspended chrome sphere on the brink of contact.
Distorted Toroid I: Singular elliptical liquid chrome ring stretching asymmetrically into a translucent glass-like membrane with icy blue caustics.
Folded Manifold I: Seamless liquid metal and nacreous silver ribbons curving gracefully out of darkness with lavender iridescence inside the crease.
Coalescing Nuclei I: Two asymmetric liquid-chrome globes suspended mid-merger, bridged by a taut translucent membrane with pale cyan caustics.
Refracted Monolith I: Vertical fluid-geometric column combining an architectural pillar with a smooth organic liquid helical twist.
Caustic Warp I: Flowing wave of sculptural liquid chrome peeling into a gossamer-thin translucent glass-like membrane with ultraviolet refraction.
Gravitational Anomaly II: Parabolic fluid meniscus rising from wide concentric ripples toward a hovering liquid-chrome sphere.
Distorted Toroid II: Nested dual rings of polished chrome and optical glass suspended diagonally with internal icy blue refraction.
Folded Manifold II: Dense cascading multi-layer silver and chrome waves with deep shadow crevices and lavender rim sheen.
Coalescing Nuclei II: Three mercury-like chrome nodes suspended in a delicate triangular glass membrane web under surface tension.
Refracted Monolith II: Faceted crystalline optical glass prism wrapped in a liquid-chrome coil with spectral dispersion.
Caustic Warp II: High-speed liquid chrome wave curling back with deep ultraviolet and lavender refraction inside its fluid crest.
Gravitational Lens: Floating horizontal disc of mirror-polished liquid chrome encased in an optical glass rim refracting cold cyan light.
